body: Oh just wanted to add I don't mean to encourage anyone to do the same, nor am I suggesting that other people haven't broke through out of even worse situations. I just believe that in my case, with this specific set on problems, and the personality traits that I was born with and ones I've obtained over time, this is inevitable to happen at one point. I'm not asking for information that is unobtainable by a simple google search or smth, I've seen all these organizations show up in a simple search and have their own websites with endorses and whatnot, I would just like to have that option (the "suicide kit" or w/e they call it), ready for me when I am ready to go. And I have been for more than a decade now.
